short: The 126th emperor, whose accession in 2019 opened the Reiwa era and left the succession unresolved.
full:
Naruhito succeeded on 1 May 2019, the day after his father's abdication, and the era name changed from Heisei to Reiwa. He was the first emperor born after the war and the first educated abroad, having spent two years at Merton College, Oxford, researching transport on the Thames. He married the diplomat Masako Owada in 1993; their daughter Aiko was born in 2001. The enthronement ceremony was held in Tokyo on 22 October 2019 before representatives of some 180 countries.

He has continued his father's practice of visiting disaster sites and speaking of the war with regret, and has made water management and scarcity his public subject. The unresolved problem of the reign is the succession. The Imperial House Law of 1947 restricts the throne to male descendants in the male line, women who marry commoners leave the family, and the only heir of Naruhito's generation or younger is his nephew Prince Hisahito, born in 2006. Successive governments have commissioned reviews and shelved them.
